summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Parveen Babi (4 April 1949 – 20 January 2005), an Indian film actress, model, and interior designer. It states she is best remembered for popular commercial films and glamorous roles opposite leading heroes of the 1970s and early 1980s. The note describes her as one of the most glamorous actresses in Hindi cinema history and one of its highest paid actresses of her time.
one_line: Biographical note on Parveen Babi, a 1970s–1980s Indian film actress, model and interior designer known for glamorous commercial film roles.
key_facts: Parveen Babi was born on 4 April 1949 and died on 20 January 2005.
Parveen Babi was an Indian film actress, model, and interior designer.
Parveen Babi is most remembered for her appearances in popular commercial films.
Parveen Babi played mostly glamorous roles alongside top heroes of the 1970s and early 1980s.
Parveen Babi is regarded as one of the most glamorous actresses in the history of Hindi Cinema.
Parveen Babi was one of the highest paid actresses of her time.
